content.comment_body: Hello. I have a 14" panel PC running Windows 10 with a touchscreen and ethernet port. Is it possible to use this device as an HMI for a [product_name]? If so, which software do I need to purchase?

[product_name] is available in several versions: [version_no], [version_no], and the latest [version_no]. Which version do you own specifically? Please provide the exact [article_no] and firmware version. Also, could you clarify your intended use case? Are you familiar with the [product_name] web server functionality? Earlier versions only offer basic web server capabilities, mirroring the display and keyboard of the device. The latest version features an enhanced web server that enables custom websites in a browser. For comprehensive HMI features, you would typically use external software such as [product_name] (TIA Portal) with a runtime license.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to use a Windows panel PC with touch support as an HMI for a [product_name] device. Responses highlight that HMI features depend on the specific product version; base models have limited web server functionality, while the newest model allows for more advanced custom web interfaces. For full HMI capability, external software like [product_name] is recommended, revealing gaps in native HMI support for earlier versions.
